+The FoundationModelsACPAgent session sent this report (SWE-bench run of 2026-10-01). The agent side of the problem is card `^64pav2a` in FoundationModelsACPAgent (the agent ends the ACP turn while a background run is in flight). This card is for the Multitool side only.

+- 13:24:33: the model calls runCode with only `return "waiting"`. This snippet also goes PENDING. It settles only at approximately 13:25:51, in the same batch as the grepCode result. A snippet that has no `await` waits behind the snippets that run.

+- Same pattern in `django__django-13447` (snippet `return "waiting for previous"`).
+
+## What the code says now
+
+- `JSCInterpreter` (`Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Interpreter/JSCInterpreter.swift:233`) states that each run has its own serial queue and its own `JSContextGroup`, so "two runs of the same interpreter never wait on each other".
+- `MultiTool.dispatchRun` (`Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/MultiTool.swift:785`) runs each snippet on `DispatchQueue.global(qos: .userInitiated)`, not on the cooperative pool.
+- Thus the Multitool design is concurrent. The serialization that the transcript shows is a defect, not a design decision. Find where it occurs. Possible locations (not verified):
+  - the background run plane of FoundationModelsExtras (`BackgroundToolRunner`) or the Router generation queue serializes the background runs of one session or of one tool;
+  - `pumpUntilSettled` or an inner `tools.*` call holds a resource that the next run also needs;
+  - the GCD global queue is at its thread limit because each suspended run holds one thread.

+- The pending text is `collectInstruction(forCompletionToken:)` (`MultiTool+Background.swift:43`).
+
+## Work
+
+1. Find the cause of the serialization. Make a snippet that does not await a slow tool start and settle while other snippets run. It must settle inside the inline settle grace and give its result inline. If a layer must be serial by design, write that in this card, and then make a new snippet wait for its turn inside the inline settle grace. Do not report it as pending at once.
+2. When the pool is full, refuse at once with one clear instruction: end the answer and wait for the named completion tokens of the running snippets. Do not add "Fix the snippet and call runCode again" to this error. Use a directive that agrees with "Do not start another now".
+3. Add this sentence to the pending envelope: "Do not call runCode to wait or to check; the result comes to you without a call."
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+
+- [ ] A test starts one snippet that awaits a slow fake tool (longer than the inline settle grace). While it runs, a second snippet `return "x"` gives its result inline, inside the grace.
+- [ ] A test fills the live-context pool. The next call gets the full-pool error, and the text does not contain "Fix the snippet and call runCode again". The text names the completion tokens to wait for, or tells the model to wait for them.
+- [ ] The pending envelope contains "Do not call runCode to wait or to check; the result comes to you without a call."
+- [ ] The card records the cause of the serialization, and the layer in which it occurred (Multitool, FoundationModelsExtras, or the ACP agent). If the cause is in another package, a card in that package exists.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+#defect
